immutable_rules: v1 mechanical artifacts are authoritative baseline for deterministic runtime behavior.
v2 GLiNER output is candidate-only and cannot auto-promote into canonical ontology artifacts.
Promotion from v2 candidates requires explicit human review and approval.
Bundle binding and reason-code determinism must remain stable across v1/v2 runs.

stages.notes: Deterministic authored baseline from canonical source and crosswalk interpretation.
Acceleration layer for candidate entities/relations pending human review.

required_actions: Review candidate entities for ontology fit and ambiguity.
Apply approved candidates into canonical artifacts in a separate authored revision.
